domain: The CM16 even latent probability table with input side N, original vocabulary V, q=2V-1 latent states, fixed fold decoder, and operator and nuclear budgets N. Add the linear output equalities of the CM18 certificate on its reached rows times reached columns. Identification is conditional on the unknown target being in the fixed paired-phase family; fitting training samples cannot test this assumption. Input token values serve only as categorical indices. Every original output class remains in ordinary softmax CE.
discovery: Only the frozen training observations, dimensions and fixed decoder enter proposal or checking. Bounded deterministic propagation retains every tried rectangle/difference proposal and refusal status, checks certificates independently and selects the largest checked coverage. It stops on complete coverage or its fixed work limits. No certificate means an explicit uncertified cell with no numerical candidate; it is not a proof of inconsistency. Partial certificates are retained. Discovery is recomputed and charged in every training mode.
solver: Uniform initial splitting state; every row projection enforces certified equalities. Full uses all CE gradients; mini retains a gradient table and the original seeded shuffle, batch size and tails; forward uses no derivatives and additionally projects observed rows to their label fibers. Each update has one spectral projection. At the original observation cadence, a checked phase anchor and at most twelve bisection rounds produce a spectral endpoint preserving certified rows. The anchor need not fit uncovered training cells, so endpoint fit is measured in every mode. Stop only after a positive update at CE excess <=1e-8, or at the update cap. No convergence theorem is claimed.
evaluation: Training metrics alone control stopping. Held-out metrics are first computed after the endpoint is fixed. Keep all 24 cases, all refusals, every original split, discovery work, update work, setup/snapshot/diagnostic work and resource measurements. A pass means at least 99 percent exact sequences on the primary split and separately on every held-out split. An independent replay repeats discovery, the entire seeded update schedule and endpoint construction, then the copied CM16 raw auditor recomputes reflected probabilities, all nonconstant complex Fourier moments, CE and every metric. Checks are numerical, not interval certificates.
comparison: After the complete frozen paired cohort and its integrated predecessor evidence exist, retain them whole. For each of 24 task/mode choices consider the certified candidate first if one exists, followed by the earlier selection. Choose the first within 1e-8 of the common training CE lower bound, otherwise the lowest training CE. Refusals leave the earlier selection in place. No held-out labels select a candidate. This adaptive eight-task extension is not an all-35 result or a fresh transformer comparison.
resources: Freeze source, protocol and producer binary before any original-task discovery or training. One numerical process and one BLAS thread in this cohort. Each process uses the user's new 64 GiB address-space cap, with explicit-buffer preflight and a 16 GiB disk reserve. Never overwrite or resume a started cell; keep generated evidence in ignored root runs. Frozen earlier cohorts retain their original limits.
